html:
Broadstreet.net Opens Office in Lancaster, SC

We are Broadstreet.net, a leading digital marketing company based in Camden, SC. We announced our expansion with the opening of a new office in Lancaster, SC. This strategic move allows us to meet the increasing demand for digital marketing services in the region while enhancing our commitment to serving local and regional clients.

Broadstreet's decision to move into Lancaster came from a recognition of the rapid growth in the area. The county boasts the highest one-year and two-year population growth in the Charlotte metro area. This expansion positions us to cater to the growing digital marketing needs of businesses in the Lancaster area, solidifying our role as a trusted digital marketing partner.

Broadstreet, led by founder and president Tom Sliker, places great importance on helping businesses establish a strong online presence. By providing search engine optimization (SEO) services, we empower small businesses to discover new customers and boost sales through effective online visibility. Our comprehensive suite of digital marketing services encompasses SEO, content marketing, social media management, web design allowing us to cater to every aspect of our clients' online needs. Broadstreet is also a Google Partner, Google Adwords Certified Consultant and Google Adwords Expert.

John McCain, President of the Lancaster Chamber of Commerce welcomed Sliker and Broadstreet to the Chamber. McCain stated,“Broadstreet brings tremendous capability to our membership.” The Chamber was grateful that Lancaster was chosen by Sliker as his new location. McCain went on to add that, “Chambers exist to serve their members and to provide programs and events that help members network and to get to know the business community that they work in.” The Chamber feels that B2B is a very important part of helping the business community grow and does a large portfolio of programs and events across the course of the year. McCain added that “within the first six months of 2023, we had 62 events of various types.”

McCain expounded on the growth of Lancaster County and proudly stated that Lancaster County is just over 100,000 people. However, 10 years ago, they were probably somewhere about 70,000. People around the country are seeing that the southeast is the place they want to be for a variety of reasons. McCain stated, “They see us as a business friendly community, welcoming community, and affordable community.”

Jessica Banks, Programs and Events Director for the Lancaster County Chamber of Commerce added that the Chamber has about 400 members and having small businesses represent the county is “super important for the growth in this area.” Banks further stated, “we're constantly planning for events that are months down the road. But more of what we do is we try to provide our businesses with a way of getting their business name out there for exposure as well as networking with the business community and heping you grow your business, which is the ultimate goal.”

In addition to Broadstreet being a member of the Lancaster Chamber, we have also sponsored the Chamber’s 7th Hole in the Rub of the Green Golf Tournament. This public event has been one of the premier chamber events that include not only members of the Chamber and area residents, but also sponsors and key community leaders from Lancaster County and surrounding communities. According to Jessica, “The golf tournament is one of our biggest events every year. We have it on October 5th this year. I believe we have 16 or 15 Hole showcase sponsors. Our sponsors have a huge impact with the success of our tournament.” The Chamber expects over 120 golfers on that day.

With the opening of our new office in Lancaster, SC, Broadstreet is well-positioned to meet the growing demand for digital marketing services in the region. Our expansion signifies the company's dedication to providing innovative and effective digital marketing solutions. Our comprehensive suite of services, coupled with our ability to transcend geographical boundaries, demonstrates our commitment to helping businesses of all sizes thrive in the digital landscape.

Broadstreet’s new office in Lancaster is located at the Connelly Building at 114 Williams Street, Lancaster, SC 29720.

If you have any questions, comments, or to get your free 30-min consultation with one of our representatives, please call (803) 575-0564. For a list of our services…click here.
